draught.definition:
n a serving of drink (usually alcoholic) drawn from a keg
n a large and hurried swallow
n a current of air (usually coming into a chimney or room or vehicle)
n the depth of a vessel's keel below the surface (especially when loaded)
n a dose of liquid medicine
n the act of moving a load by drawing or pulling
v make a blueprint of
draught.translation:
n. 气流, 草稿, 汇票, 通风, 拉, 牵引
vt. 起草, 征兵, 选派

draught excluder.translation: 防风条, 门槛嵌缝条

draughtboard.definition:
n. A checkered board on which draughts are played. See
   Checkerboard.

draughted.translation:
n. 气流；汇票；草稿（等于draft）
vt. 起草；征兵；选派（等于draft）
a. 汲出的；拖拉的（等于draft）

draughtier.translation: a. 通风良好的, 有隙缝风吹入的( draughty的比较级 )

draughtiest.translation: a. 通风良好的, 有隙缝风吹入的( draughty的最高级 )

draughtproofed.translation: (draughtproof 的过去分词) adj. 防风的；防隙风的

draughtproofing.translation: (draughtproof 的现在分词) adj. 防风的；防隙风的

draughts.definition:
n a checkerboard game for two players who each have 12 pieces; the object is to jump over and so capture the opponent's pieces
n a serving of drink (usually alcoholic) drawn from a keg
n a large and hurried swallow
n a current of air (usually coming into a chimney or room or vehicle)
n the depth of a vessel's keel below the surface (especially when loaded)
n a dose of liquid medicine
n the act of moving a load by drawing or pulling
v make a blueprint of

draughtsman.definition: n a skilled worker who draws plans of buildings or machines
draughtsman.translation: n. 起草人, 打样人, 制图员, (正式)制图能手

draughtsmanship.definition: n. The office, art, or work of a draughtsman.

draughtsmen.translation: n. 起草人；制图员；跳棋棋子
